usedFor: Zoho CRM holds accounts and deals, and Callingly receives each new account as a client through “Create Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Create Client” in Callingly
bestTemplate.why: A new account in Zoho CRM becomes a Callingly client, so calling starts without retyping.

watchOut: “New Account” in Zoho CRM is polling, so “Create Client” runs after a scheduled check.
